description: Search every public dataset on Mostly Right and return up to 20 matches, most relevant first, as {results: [{id, title, url, snippet, matching_table, why}]}, where `id` is the dataset slug, `url` its canonical page, and snippet, matching_table and why say what matched. No account needed. Example: {"query": "hourly airport weather observations"}. Pass a result's `id` straight to fetch for the full dataset document. This is the plain search-and-fetch pair; search_datasets is the richer, paged version with topics, publishers and summaries. matching_table can name a raw input table. Tables named source_* hold raw inputs; prefer main_table from list_tables.
name: search
title: Search datasets
